author: GamingBolt
description:
Raccoon City is among the most iconic locations in the Resident Evil franchise, being a place where so much of its history is rooted, and a stage for more of the franchise to bring its actors to. But to us, it's more than just a city devastated by the Umbrella Corporation's illegal research and selfish interests. It's an emotion. Or a bunch of them. 

It's a place of fond memories, It's one that has given so many great characters their time to shine. It's a showcase of why Resident Evil has managed to be an important player in the survival horror genre. Join us as we take a fond look at why the city deserves a place of honor among the genre's finest, and why it's been so crucial to the success of the games that it housed.
title: Resident Evil - What Makes Raccoon City So LEGENDARY?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Tarsier Studios is back to what they do best, with Reanimal taking everything the studio did well with the Little Nightmares franchise and dialling it all up to a hundred as indicated by the game's early previews. 

With a new duo of protagonists, a dark, gritty, and terrifying world to explore, and deadly threats hidden away behind complex puzzles that are going to test your brains (and nerves), this is an experience to look forward to with enthusiasm.

Take a look at our list of things you need to know about before you decide to take the plunge, and learn more about a title that we just can't wait to play.
title: Reanimal - 15 Gameplay Details You Need To Know BEFORE YOU BUY
